title: Interaction Issue: session_to_python_script doesnt work with gemini api
author: migratesky

comments.author: shoaib027
comments.body: You are passing the wrong agent instance to `export_to_ipynb` and `session_to_python_script`. Both functions expect a `CodeAgent` type, but an `Agent` instance is currently being passed. This is not a bug. Hope this solves the issue

comments.author: laithrw
comments.body: Closing; you passed Agent instead of CodeAgent to session_to_python_script()). Both CodeAgent and session_to_python_script have since been removed from the codebase.
